items.body:
<details open>

qwen2vl : apply FFN weight scales (#32241)

The qwen2vl graph passed NULL for the ffn_up/gate/down scales, so the
per-tensor NVFP4 scales loaded by the generic pass were never applied
and the model produced garbage (PPL ~1e6 on CUDA, NaN on CPU).

Pass the scales to build_ffn like qwen2 does.

Fixes #32101

</details>
